text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is supposed to be pool training, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I left my things in the locker room... and 
came straight here.
choice_data_list:
...Change of plans. Let's stick to 
classroom study for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's training, she lacks 
focus. Perhaps fatigue has built up from 
back-to-back races. We might need to 
review her schedule.
